name: Phantom Thief
description: Locked chests open without a check and their traps are disarmed; your Fortune cap is 35%; in-dungeon chests roll a grade up twice as often for you.

effects.note: locked chests open with no check and no trap; chests roll a grade up percent% as often (delve side)
the Fortune cap becomes amount% (stub: a stats.ts joint)

mastery.text: Also Skeleton Keys are never consumed.

effects.note: Skeleton Keys are never used up (delve side)
